comparisons.name: find-my-light
comparisons.description: The disc of "Me" in Find My's People list, Aqua: 36 x 36 pt of the sidebar with the disc, its grey gradient and the white silhouette. Nothing is masked: the silhouette is the library's own drawing, placed and sized where the capture has the head and the shoulders.

comparisons.name: find-my-dark
comparisons.description: The disc of "Me" in Find My's People list, Dark Aqua, with the black hairline just outside the disc. Nothing is masked.

comparisons.name: sizes-light
comparisons.description: What the reference comparison cannot pin down, Aqua: the silhouette is white where the capture's is, the disc shows between its head and shoulders and at its rim, and a 48 pt avatar scales all of it.

the disc 1.5 pt above its bottom, under the shoulders: nearly the gradient's last colour, #868a93 (spec: disc, bottom, measured)
